item.title: ヘアカットごっこおもちゃ 木製美容室セット 収納袋
features: 【Wooden Build】 Unlike plastic pretend play sets, this barbershop set is made of quality wood, offering durability and a realistic feel for lasting imaginative play.
【Compact Size】 The set measures 23 x 15 x 5 cm, easy to store and carry, perfect for at-home or on-the-go play.
【Real-World Scenarios】 Children can role-play as barbers or stylists, cutting and styling pretend hair, boosting creativity and social skills during playdates or solo play.
【Inclusive Play】 Designed for both girls and boys aged 3+, all accessories are stored in a handy cloth bag for tidy storage and portability.
【Complete Set】 Includes a storage bag, hair dryer, clipper, hair straightener, hand mirror, comb, and hairspray for a full salon experience.
